description: This PHP class 'ComponentGenerator' manages Drupal component dependencies, including locating composer.json files, reconciling dependencies with core, and updating component JSON files.

classes.name: ComponentGenerator
classes.description: Manages Drupal component dependencies, including locating composer.json files, reconciling dependencies with core, and updating component JSON files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the component base directory path.

methods.name: getComponentPathsFinder
methods.description: Finds all composer.json files for components within the component directory.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Reconciles Drupal components when composer.lock is updated, generating component packages as needed.

methods.name: generateComponentPackage
methods.description: Generates or updates a component's composer.json file if changes are detected.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Reconciles component dependencies with core, returning structured JSON data.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes JSON data into a pretty-printed string with unescaped slashes.

methods.name: initialPackageMetadata
methods.description: Provides default metadata for all components, including readme note and PHP requirement.
